headline: 63 Moons Technologies shares jump 12% following subsidiary's upgraded FY27 outlook
hook: Subsidiary revises financial targets sharply higher
summary: Shares of 63 Moons Technologies surged 12 per cent after its subsidiary raised its FY27 revenue guidance from ₹350 crore to ₹600 crore. The substantial revision in projected financials triggered strong buying interest in the parent company's stock. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap and technology-linked infrastructure plays should note how subsidiary performance impacts parent valuations.
why_it_matters: Subsidiary growth boosts parent company stock value.

headline: 63 Moons shares jump on raised guidance for cybertech unit
summary: 63 Moons Technologies shares rose 9% following an upward revision in revenue guidance for its subsidiary, 63SATS Cybertech. The unit now expects Rs 600 crore in billed revenue for FY27, significantly higher than the previous target of Rs 350 crore. The company reported Rs 218 crore in billings for the first half of the fiscal year, attributing the growth to strong execution and a robust business pipeline.
why_it_matters: Higher subsidiary revenue projections boost parent company valuation expectations
